blocks.content:
• CIC established under RTI Act, 2005.
• Maximum 10 Information Commissioners.
• Appointment by President.
• Penalty up to ₹25,000.
• Second appeal lies with CIC.

items: Exams often trick candidates on the appointing authority: CIC members are appointed by the President, not the Prime Minister.
Remember the maximum ceiling for Information Commissioners is 10.
Be clear that the second appeal lies with the CIC, not the first appeal.
The maximum penalty cap of ₹25,000 is a frequently asked numerical fact.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Central Information Commission (CIC) was established under the RTI Act, 2005.
The commission can have a maximum of 10 Information Commissioners.
Members of the CIC are appointed by the President of India.
A penalty of up to ₹25,000 can be imposed under the RTI Act.
The second appeal under the RTI framework lies with the CIC.
